Name: (CF) Nano's Decorative Tree Furniture
Author: echocandy404
Description:
已在小红书上得到了Nano老师的授权。
It has been authorized by Nano in [i]Xiaohongshu[/i].
中国宝宝有问题也可私信我小红书 @左岸瑾

只兼容1.5版本。Nano's Decorative Tree Furniture的 CF 版本。
Only Compatible with 1.5.  Custom furniture version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22954]Nano's Decorative Tree Furniture[/url].


需要定制家具，请使用0.12.0、1.14.0版本（手机端也可使用）。[b][u]似乎某些CF版本不能在室外摆放家具时，请首选下载以上版本！
[/u][/b]Need Custom Furniture, use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1254?tab=files&file_id=39334]Custom Furniture 0.12.0[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1254?tab=files&file_id=67644]1.14.0[/url] (Android same).[b][u]It seems that some CF versions can't put furniture outdoors, Please download the above version first![/u][/b]
[b][u]
[/u][/b]由于CF不支持灯具贴图的昼夜变化，我在美观方面把所以灯具贴图截取只保留发光后的贴图。（已准许修改
Because CF does not support day and night switching of lamps. I cut out all the non-glowing lamp.png from an aesthetic point of view and kept only the glowing lamp.png.(Modifications have been granted.

[u]小红书看到有人问关于放置灯具时不发光的问题：这是CF的通病小bug。刚放上去不发光，你只需要走出房间或地图，再走进来，它就能正常发光了。
If someone ask about the problem that the lamp does not glow when it is placed: this is a common bug of CF. When you put it on, it doesn't glow, you just need to walk out of the room or the map, walk in again, and it will glow normally.
[/u]

家具描述文本只有中文。
Furniture description text is only in Chinese.

我还是个新手。如果有任何问题可以给我留言。
上传的图片是我在游戏内测试Nano部分家具的展示截图。
I'm still a novice. Leave me a message if you have any questions.
The mod image is a screenshot of me testing Nano furniture in the game.


请不要将本mod上传到其它网站，禁止商用。
This mod is only uploaded to Nexusmods, please do not upload it to any other websites.   
Please do not use this mod for any business or profit purpose.
